mapper.update: MERGE INTO PAGE_CONTENT t USING (SELECT #{adminIdx, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS ADMIN_IDX, #{pageKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PAGE_KEY, #{contentText, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CONTENT_TEXT FROM DUAL) s ON (t.ADMIN_IDX = s.ADMIN_IDX AND t.PAGE_KEY = s.PAGE_KEY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CONTENT_TEXT = s.CONTENT_TEXT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ADMIN_IDX, PAGE_KEY, CONTENT_TEXT) VALUES (s.ADMIN_IDX, s.PAGE_KEY, s.CONTENT_TEXT)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PAGE_CONTENT WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND PAGE_KEY = #{pageKey}
